jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
Organization Overview

Job Description – Executive Director

Located in Carmel, Indiana, The Children’s TherAplay Foundation, Inc. is a not-for-profit outpatient pediatric rehabilitation clinic. Children's TherAplay is one of the few clinics in the country that specializes in physical and occupational therapies on horseback for children with special needs. Our therapists combine a sensory-rich, child-centered clinic with hippotherapy ,
a treatment strategy incorporating the movement of horses, to provide carefully graded motor sensory, and neurological input for children ages 18 months to 13 years.

Position Overview

SUMMARY OF PRIMARY DUTIES & REPSONSBILITIES:

The Executive Director serves as the chief executive officer of the Foundation, providing visionary leadership for an organization that uniquely combines philanthropy with the direct delivery of pediatric therapy services including innovative equine-assisted therapy.

Unlike a traditional nonprofit Executive Director role, this position is responsible for both advancing the Foundation's mission through fundraising, donor engagement, board partnership, financial stewardship, and community leadership, and overseeing the day-to-day operations of a multidisciplinary pediatric therapy clinic that incorporates hippotherapy into each child’s therapy program. The Foundation's philanthropic efforts directly sustain and expand the clinical services that transform the lives of children and families.

The Executive Director leads an organization of more than 40 employees, including occupational, physical, and speech-language therapists, equine specialists and barn staff, administrative professionals, and support personnel.

Success in this role requires an executive who can seamlessly integrate mission, strategy, philanthropy, healthcare operations, financial management, and organizational culture to maximize both community impact and long-term sustainability.

PRIMARY DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITES

Organizational leadership and Strategy

Lead the development and execution of the organization’s strategic plan, annual workplan, and budget in partnership with the department leaders and the Board of Directors.
Provide clear organizational visions and direction while supporting innovation, adaptability, and long-term sustainability.
Work collaboratively with the Board of Directors to maximize effectiveness and strategic alignment of board committees.
Ensure appropriate tracking and measurement of key performance indicators across all departments.

People and Culture

Lead, support, and develop staff; establish organizational structure, role clarity, and performance expectations in a dynamic environment.
Oversee core human resource functions in collaboration with our HR Lead to ensure hiring, midyear and annual evaluations, performance improvements for employees, and compliance.
Collaborate with the department leaders and Board of Directors to establish staff compensation, including salaries and benefits.

Fundraising

Lead and actively participate in fundraising efforts, including development of goals and strategies, prospect planning, donor cultivation, relationship stewardship, and reporting. Serve as Children’s TherAplay’s primary spokesperson and representative with donors, partners, media, community leaders, and the public.
Support the Development team in ensuring a culture of philanthropy among Children’s TherAplay’s Board of Directors, staff, and volunteers.

Operations and Management

Oversee organizational operations and work in collaboration with Director of Operations, including governance, programs, fundraising, equine department, communications, partnerships, human resources, and compliance.
Oversee and manage the annual operating budget; oversee forecasting and ensuring budget to actual expenses are in line and variances are appropriately shared with the Board.
Ensure strong internal systems, policies, and practices across finance, human resources, fundraising, marketing, communications, safety, equine programs, successional planning, and programming.
Manage and collaborate with staff for facility maintenance and renovations.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Is deeply passionate about serving children with disabilities and their families, connecting donors with giving that is meaningful to them, strengthening communities, and empowering the team who makes our mission possible.
Will promote and increase the organization’s visibility, credibility, and impact across central Indiana and beyond.
Promotes a collaborative leadership style, with experience leading large teams as well as external consultants, and has experience in leading through service, trust, and shared accountability.
Is a strategic thinker who can balance vision with execution.
Has a successful track record of navigating complex funding sources and relationships, including local officials, private foundations, and key donors.
Demonstrates strong written and oral communication skills, and the ability to engage diverse audiences.
Demonstrates a commitment to treating all people with dignity and respect and fostering an environment where everyone can contribute and succeed.

Education, Experience, And Licensing Requirments

The candidate must possess five or more years in an organizational leadership role. Direct supervisory experience at a senior management level is preferred but not required. A history of success in not-for-profit fundraising planning and implementation and experience with organizational fiscal processes including budget planning and management is required. Professional experience within awareness of the healthcare industry is preferred but not required. Minimum of a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with an emphasis in not-for-profit, healthcare, or business is required.

The Children’s TherAplay Foundation, Inc. (Children’s TherAplay) provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Children’s TherAplay complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and

conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Children’s TherAplay expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Children’s TherAplay employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to andincluding discharge.

jobs.title: Community Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Description

THE COMPANY

Cogir Senior Living, based in Scottsdale, Arizona, proudly oversees a network of senior living communities spanning 11 states nationwide. As a trusted leader in senior housing, we are dedicated to growth while maintaining our commitment to exceptional care for our residents and a supportive, growth-focused environment for our team members.

At Cogir, our culture is rooted in the core values of human focus, creativity, and excellence, which inspire us to continuously improve and achieve excellence in all we do. Join us in our mission to enrich the lives of our residents while building a meaningful and fulfilling career!

What We Offer

Compensation includes a base salary and a generous, accelerating commission structure!
Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance.
Early access to paycheck (pay on demand).
401K with company match.
Paid Vacation, Holidays, and Sick Leave.
Employee Assistance Program,
Generous Employee Referral Program and more.

Position Summary

The Community Business Development Director will be responsible for cultivating and nurturing relationships and partnerships with key local and industry professionals, as well as paid and non-paid referral sources and community representatives in the region. This role will involve generating qualified leads for the community and enhancing brand awareness and positioning in the market. Reporting to the Regional Director of Business Optimization, the Director of Business Development will create and execute a purposeful monthly and quarterly calendar of external and internal events, capturing and tracking them in the community CRM (Yardi) on a daily basis. Working closely with the sales and operations team in the community, as well as the regional and corporate marketing teams, this role will be pivotal in driving external business results that align with organizational occupancy and revenue goals.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement a robust monthly external development and events plan for the community, consistent with the company's objectives.
Design, implement, and facilitate the yearly strategic business development plan with input and support from the Executive Director, corporate marketing, and operations teams.
Develop and manage referral partnerships and track all activity in the CRM.
Maintain and/or improve community occupancy level and revenue production through the development of more lead volume and the generation of strong, qualified leads.
Conduct scheduled tours with key professionals and industry leaders.
Provide a weekly activity plan and reports that document appointments, outcomes, and next steps.
Have impeccable follow-up and communication skills.
Maintain the community's Customer Relationship Management software (Yardi) accurately and promptly.
Participate in local and regional networking events, representing the community and company.
Understand the community's care offerings and Cogir programs that are differentiators to ensure proper placement and education in the community.
Participate in and represent the community in outreach events, networking meetings, trade shows, and other community functions.
Monitor and maintain promotional item inventory; assess print advertising needs.
Manage social media accounts if applicable.
Adhere to sales and marketing budget and provide input and accurate pricing information for ads, directories, social media advertising, event costs, association memberships, and all marketing and sales-related costs, working with community, regional, and corporate teams.

Requirements

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

Education

A Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of experience and education is required.

Experience, Competencies, And Skills

A positive, curious, and dynamic leader who loves to engage with others daily.
3-5 years of experience in senior living external business development and sales preferred.
Has a proven track record in achieving and exceeding sales goals.
Ability to manage time effectively, high initiative, and good judgment.
Demonstrate professional ethics with a positive attitude, exceptional verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to motivate others and work within a team environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and CRM.

Salary Description

60,000 to 70,000 plus commission
